notes: Reached exclusively through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in my own tab (no HTTP/proxy route used). robots.txt (https://www.juttu.be/robots.txt) read in-tab first: only a generic User-agent:* block (disallows /api*, /checkout*, /account*, /lister.html*, /buy*, *&filter=*) plus full disallows for Baiduspider and Sosospider - no Claude/Anthropic/ClaudeBot rule, so extraction is permitted. Note the site's own search results live at the robots-disallowed /nl/lister.html?q=..., so I deliberately did NOT use site search; absence was proven from the sitemap and the site's own facet taxonomy instead. Juttu (Retail Concepts N.V. / JBC group, BTW BE 0416.762.280) is a Belgian multi-department lifestyle concept store - fashion (Dames/Heren), Food, personal care, books/media, and one 'Home & Deco' department. Platform is Adobe AEM, server-rendered listings, URL shape /nl/c/<dept>/<sub>/<leaf>.html. CATEGORY TREE SOURCE: (a) the 'Alle home & deco categorieen' link block on https://www.juttu.be/nl/c/home-deco.html, which enumerates every Home & Deco leaf (Meubilair, Verlichting, Fotolijsten & posters, Decoratie, Spiegels, Vazen & bloempotten, Kaarsen en kandelaars, Kussens, Plaids, Tapijten, Handdoeken, Keuken, Gadgets, Opbergen, Tuin); and (b) the full category sitemap https://www.juttu.be/sitemap/category-1.xml fetched same-origin from the loaded page - 292 Dutch category URLs in total. Scanning all 292 against furniture slugs (meubel|meubil|stoel|zetel|bed|kast|rek|bureau|kruk|sofa|fauteuil|chair|table|desk|cabinet|shelv|bookcase|dressoir|poef|tuinset|lounge) returned exactly ONE furniture category: /nl/c/home-deco/wonen/meubilair.html (the only other hits were /nl/c/home/tablet-laptop-sleeves.html and a greeting-card node - both false positives). ABSENCE CROSS-CHECK: the department-wide listing https://www.juttu.be/nl/c/home-deco/alle-producten.html exposes the site's own 'Type product' facet across the entire Home & Deco catalogue, and it reports Meubilair(2) as the only furniture product type - every other value is non-furniture (Keukenservies 181, Keukengerei 132, Accessoires 80, Kaarsen 51, Speelgoed binnen 34, Vazen en bloempotten 31, Textiel accessoires 18, Geurstokjes 15, Opbergen 10, Papierwaren 10, Tuinaccessoires 10, Hobby en creatie 9, Media accessoires 8, Gadgets 5, Planten 4, Strandlaken 4, Fotolijsten en posters 3, Verlichting 3, Decoratie 2, Handdoeken 2, Keukentextiel 2, Curated space 1). So there is no outdoor/garden furniture (Tuin resolves to Tuinaccessoires + Planten), no bathroom or office furniture, and 'Opbergen' is standalone storage goods, not storage furniture. QTY: Meubilair verified three consistent ways - rendered listing header '2 producten', the page's own 'Type product' facet 'Meubilair(2)', and the department-wide facet 'Meubilair(2)'; two separate page loads gave the same number (no drift). Sanity checks passed: h1 of the loaded page is 'Meubilair' and rel=canonical is /nl/c/home-deco/wonen/meubilair.html (no silent parent-listing substitution); the number is not the site-wide total (675) nor a round display cap; the two tiles are genuine furniture (&KLEVERING 'Tafel Pillar Marshmallow Burgendy' = table, Madam Stoltz 'Stoel Wooden Chair With Armrest And Rattan' = chair). Meubilair has NO child nodes or sub-facets, so it is recorded as a leaf, not a grouping row. Never-extract nodes dropped per brief section 3: 'Alle home & deco producten', 'New collection', 'Bestsellers', seasonal pages (Kerst/Pasen/Lente/Zomer), 'Ronde prijzen' / 'Korting for ju' / 'Mid-season madness' promo pages, 'Merken' brand pages, and Lookbook/Inspiratie editorial. Link recorded is the clean canonical origin URL with no filter query string (the site's filter URLs are robots-disallowed).
